title: AION 2 Assassin: Skills, Insignias and PvE Builds
description: Learn Assassin back attacks, Insignia stacks, Heart Gore triggers, Stigma choices and a manual opener for bosses, farming and PvP.
summary: Build Assassin damage around safe back attacks, critical opportunities and an Insignia finisher.
quickAnswer: Assassin uses dual daggers. Build up to five Insignias with Savage Roar and available attacks, then use Insignia Explosion. Shadowstrike helps reach the back; Heart Gore depends on a critical trigger.
